preconditions.description: The length of the text is between 1 and 2,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.splitlines()[1])
preconditions.description: The text contains only lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is within the range 0 to 51123986 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(text)) for j in range(i + 1, len(text)) for k in range(i, j + 1) for l in range(k + 1, j + 1) if text[i:j+1] == text[i:j+1][::-1] and text[k:l+1] == text[k:l+1][::-1] and not (i <= k <= j <= l or k <= i <= l <= j))
postconditions.description: The output is the number of different pairs of crossing subpalindromes in the text, modulo 51123987.
